## About Me

> “I’m a Health Economist passionate about advancing health equity through decision-analytic modeling and evidence-based policy. Beyond research, I’m a curious traveler and cultural explorer who has called Vietnam, Sweden, the UK, and Puerto Rico home. Off-duty, you’ll find me exploring local food cultures, open waters, and bouldering or simply enjoying good books and time with cats.”
